one_line: One joke sentence on screen from frame one over a laughing child using the product, no talking needed.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld medium shot: a man holds the handle of a blue harness while a baby in it swings and kicks above the floor. Text from the first frame: "קנית נדנדה ניידת מאליאקספרס וככה אירגנת לבעלך אימון ידיים". No speech.
q1_hook.why: A joke addressed to mothers sits in the first frame beside a laughing baby already using the product, so the topic and the payoff are clear at once (H1, H2, K3). With no voice and no cut before 18 s, the hook relies on the text and the baby's motion (H4, H6 not met).

beats.what: A man holds the harness handle in a hallway; the baby swings and kicks, laughing; fixed joke text
beats.why: Joke and result in one frame, nothing to set up

beats.what: The camera moves closer; the baby swings in wider arcs
beats.why: Bigger motion and a closer view lift energy

beats.what: The camera steps back; the man bounces the baby up and down, laughing
beats.why: His laugh answers the "arm workout" joke
Resets the picture before the second half

beats.what: Low close frame at the man's waist: the baby faces the lens, the penguin-faced panel in view
beats.why: Shows the harness up close, the baby's legs paddling

beats.what: The baby bounces in the foreground, a play mat below; the same text
beats.why: Same view and action again, nothing new

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. The caption is "הרגליים הרוקדות" plus hashtags. The joke is a relatable moment a parent might send to a partner, but nothing invites it.
q2_flow.why: The joke and the laughing baby show up in the first second, so no setup is needed (H1, K3). The man's laugh at 0:17 and the angle change at 0:19 refresh the picture (R3). After 0:20 the same bouncing view runs 17 s with no new information, and the video has no payoff beat or ending (R1, R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video or the caption. The only commercial word is the store, "מאליאקספרס", inside the joke text. Caption: "הרגליים הרוקדות", emojis, five hashtags.
q3_cta.why: No ask, which also avoids engagement bait on a joke made for reach (C2). The cost: a viewer who wants the harness gets only the store name, with no product name, price or link (C6, C7).

q4_shown.what: A blue harness with a handle and a penguin-faced chest panel, a baby inside swinging, bouncing and kicking, held by a man's hands (0:00 to 0:37). The panel is clear from 0:20. No price, brand, age or safety information.
q4_shown.why: The product is in use from the first frame and the proof is the baby's laugh (S1, K8). A man's hands on the handle carry the demo (S4). No age, fit or safety information appears, and no principle here covers it. A baby's face is on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: Two handheld takes (0:00 to 0:18, 0:20 to 0:37) joined by a whip blur at 0:19, so about 2 shots, about 18 s each. No speed change seen. One fixed text box for the whole Reel. No speech; ends on the baby's legs mid-kick.
q5_edit.why: A single moving take keeps an unedited feel, and the camera's and the baby's motion supply change (F8). But 37 s with no cuts, no new text and one repeated action is long for one joke (R1, R2, E2). It ends mid-kick with no payoff or CTA (E8).

q6_topic.what: A joke about a baby harness bought online that gives the father an arm workout. Serves parents who laugh at the effort of baby play.
q6_topic.why: The joke comes from a lived parenting moment, holding a bouncing baby, and the baby's laugh gives the positive peak (K3, K1). A parent can send it to a partner (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone video in a home hallway with warm light. First 18 s: medium shots of a man and a baby swinging. Then a low, close frame at his waist, the baby facing the lens. His face is seen only in the first take.
q7_filmed.why: Handheld and unpolished, it looks like a family moment, not an ad (H8). The low close take fills the frame with harness and baby (F4). Motion blur on fast kicks costs sharpness (F7), and the text sits at 65 to 74% of the frame height, in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: One fixed text box, white bold with a dark outline, three centred lines in the lower third, 0:00 to 0:37, never changing: "קנית נדנדה ניידת מאליאקספרס וככה אירגנת לבעלך אימון ידיים" plus a laughing emoji. No headline card, no subtitles.
q8_text.caption: "הרגליים הרוקדות" with eight melting-face emojis, then five generic hashtags (#תינוקות #תאומים #אמא #אבא #אמהות). Two words of text, no question, no CTA, no product word.
q8_text.why: The joke card is readable at once and carries the whole hook, so it works muted (T3, T1). White with a dark outline stays legible (T5). It stays unchanged for 37 s, three lines in the bottom 35% (T4, T2). The caption has no product or occasion words; hashtags are generic (T7).

weak_points: 37 s for one joke, the last 17 s adding nothing new; no age, safety or fit information; the baby looks serious in several later frames; text in the bottom 35%; caption without keywords; no CTA.
lumebook_takeaway: Put one joke line on screen from frame one over a single continuous handheld take of the book in use, then cut at the payoff. Hands only, no child.
not_verified: Whether the man is the father or the account owner's partner; whether the account owner is the mother; the harness brand; any speech, laughter or music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה"); the baby's age and any safety guidance. Correction to src/coded: frames show 2 handheld takes joined by a whip blur at 0:19, not 4 segments; no jump cuts seen.
